name: HWR_DI_CONNECTOR_DEF
description: This table stores the DI (Flow based) connector definition.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for this table.

columns.name: FILE_CONTENTS
columns.description: The contents of the OpenAPI(Swagger) file.

columns.name: ICON_IMG
columns.description: The image file for the connector icon.

columns.name: CONNECTOR_TYPE
columns.description: Record the type of the connector, communication, social reputation, wellness.

columns.name: OVERALL_STATUS
columns.description: The indicator showing the current status of the overall definition.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: The indicator showing the top-level steps where the guided process to resume from.

columns.name: FROM_SEEDED
columns.description: Indicate if a connector is created from seeded open api or not.

columns.name: SEEDED_CONNECTOR_TYPE
columns.description: The column stores the connector type if created from the seeded template.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
